Ṭikaṇikāyātrā
jy. on vivāha; by Varāhamihira. Nepal I. p.. 26-28 (no. 933; third work in codex). IO. 6381E.
One ms. in Rajguru Hemaraj's private collection, no. 431.
Numerous citations in Adbhutasāgara of Ballālasena.
Ed. J. Bomb. Uni. XX (NS) ii (Sept. 1951) p.. 40-63.

Ṭīkākāra
commentator on Bharata's Nāṭya Śāstra. cited often by Abhinavagupta.
See R. C. Pandey, Abhinavagupta (1963 edn.), p. 928; V. Raghavan, JOR. Madras. VI. p. 200.

Ṭīkākāra(mayūkha)
authority ref. to by Viṭṭhalapaṇḍita in his Vāgbhaṭamaṇḍana, med. Bomb. Uni. 227.

Ṭīkākārayavanakara
an. C. R. A. Sastri III. p. 232. [Page002-a.

Ṭīkākāra_Śarman
or Ārambhaṭīkākāraśarman.
--Piṣṭapaśukhaṇḍana. Baroda 2436. Hpr. III. 178.

Ṭīkākārasamuccaya
lex. by Śucinātha. Mithilā.

Ṭīkākṛt
lex. on Amara ?
Q. in Ṭīkāsarvasva, TSS. edn. Pt. III. p.. 154. 282.

Ṭīkācārya
a. epithet of Jayatīrtha. PUL. II. p. 45. Rice 146.
--C. on Trivikrama's Daśaprakaraṇa. PUL. II. p. 45. Rice 148.

Ṭīkāpatrāṇi_(?)
unspecified. Dāhilakṣmī I. 16.

Ṭīkābhaṭṭa
father of Dvārakanātha (a. of C. Dīpikā on Baudh. śulbasūtra. RASB. II. 606).

Ṭīkāratna
unspecified. Puliyannur Mana 109. Trippūṇittura II. 328. 329.
See next.

Ṭīkāratna
name of C. by Ānandapūrṇa on Pañcapādikā, Bikaner 6484.

Ṭīkārāma
--C. Tattvavivekinī on Śiva (pratyāhara) sūtra. Trav. Uni. 7494.

Ṭīkārāma
--Dāyamuktāvalī. Oudh XIV. 62.

Ṭīkārāma
--Naiyāyikabhūṣaṇa. Mithilā.

Ṭīkārāma
son of Bhāskara.
--Mantravāridhi. Fl. 381.

Ṭīkārthadīpikā
name of C.. by Viṭṭhala of Vānivālakula on Tattvasaṅkhyāna. Adyar D. X. 665. Extr. p. 426.

Ṭīkāsamuccayasāra
Q. by Rāyamukuṭa in his C. Padacandrikā on Amarakośa II. 25.

Ṭīkāsarvasva
name of C. by Vandyaghaṭīya Sarvānanda on Amarakośa.
Pt.. TSS. 38, 43, 51, 52. [Page002-b]

Ṭīkāsāra
Q. by Rāyamukuṭa in his C. Padacandrikā on Amarakośa, II. 4. 1. 10.

Ṭīkāsārasaṅgraha
name of C. by Uttamabodhayati on Bhāgavata. GD. 143-5. TCD. 185.

Ṭīkāsārasamuccaya
comments on diff. cyclic years. a.. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 47 (Q. s. from Rudrasvāmin's Śuklaṭīkā. Ms. d. Sam3. 1322).
